title: Sing Pal Sings
style: gritty female vocals, hard rock, synth bass, breaks, female vocals, warm, steady, deep
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah
Like a song pal
Sing it back to me

[Verse]
Yeah
Like a song pal
You could be my song pal forever
We should just be song pals not text pals
We're gonna get it right you'll sing
Pal
I know what's right tonight
I went away to go and find my way
You came along and you heard my melody
You stayed and listened while I played that tune
And now it's you I want to hear sing back to me
No more pen pals no more text at all
I want your heartbeat keeping time with me
Just your warm chest humming to my call
To a tune like I said baby sing it back to me

[Chorus]
Be my song pal be my song pal
Sing it back to me sing it back to me
Be my song pal be my song pal
Like I said baby sing it back to me
Be my song pal be my song pal
Every little note send it back to me
Be my song pal be my song pal
Like I said pal sing it back to me

[Outro]
Okay hold up
It's not all luck
We all go this thing
Let me make it ring
You can look
Read ya book
Go on then have a good look again
You can tell you
What you want to
You can believe too
If you want to
You really want to know?
Think like that
Yeah like that
Enough with the text
Emotionless comments
No dislikes
I like
No dislikes
No dislikes
Yeah that is what I like
We ain't gonna roll like that
Stat stat stat
Sing it back
From your chest to my content
Like a pen pal
My song pal
Assume sometimes
Unless you ask
I guess we all have to assume that
Assume that we do not assume
But we have to
Assume mode stays
No stall phrase
Build it now
Lock it down
Yeah no stop
Let me hear what you got
